title: A Fork Into the Corner
setup: Black's king is tucked into the h8 corner behind its own pawns, and Black's rook on d8 has no defender.
hint: Find the knight check that also attacks the rook. The king will have only one square to go to.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nf7+}} checks the king on h8 and attacks the rook on d8. The pawns on g7 and h7 leave the king one square, and from g8 it cannot reach d8. After {{Kg8}}, {{Nxd8}} takes the rook, and you go from an exchange down to a knight up.

A king boxed in by its own pawns is the easiest target for a fork.
